description:
Redwood Inference is running multiple pricing/packaging experiments while relying on usage-based billing derived from token- and request-level meters. This project validates that billing meters are correct (sanity checks + reconciliation to source telemetry), analyzes experiment outcomes (conversion, expansion, churn risk, margin/unit economics), and publishes internal guidance for Sales/CS/Product on how to quote, interpret usage, and handle discrepancies.

Goals:
- Meter sanity checks: confirm token meters, embedding units, rerank units, streaming accounting, retries, caching/batching effects, and rounding rules are consistently captured across telemetry → aggregation → invoicing.
- Experiment analysis: produce statistically defensible readouts for active/paused pricing tests (plan gating, free credits, overage pricing, Dedicated commit structure), including segmentation by customer tier, model family, region, and workload type.
- Guidance + controls: publish a single source of truth for meter definitions, known edge cases, escalation paths, and how Finance/RevOps/Sales should respond to disputes or anomalous usage.

Scope:
- In-scope: hosted API usage meters, Dedicated usage attribution and contract commits, invoice line-item mapping, console usage reporting alignment, anomaly detection/alerting, customer-facing explanations (internal enablement), and legal review of metering/measurement language.
- Out-of-scope: new pricing strategy from scratch, major billing system replatforming, net-new contract templates (beyond targeted clause updates), and non-usage revenue recognition policy redesign.

Key stakeholders and roles:
- Finance: Laura Bennett (exec sponsor), Rishi Malhotra (FP&A / unit economics), Emily Stone (billing controls and close support).
- Legal: Michael Grant (GC), Sofia Mendes (commercial counsel; metering/measurement language and dispute clauses).
- Product/RevOps: Chris Osei (product ops; experiment tracking + comms), Isabelle Laurent (sales ops; quoting/CRM hygiene).
- Engineering: Logan Wright (Telemetry & Analytics), Nadia Rahman (metering pipelines), Cole Summers (quotas & billing hooks), Allison Grant (observability/alerts), Ethan Park (platform control plane integration).

Timeline (typical 6–8 week push aligned to a monthly invoice cycle):
1) Kickoff + inventory (week 1): enumerate meters, dashboards, experiments, and known edge cases; define success criteria.
2) Meter reconciliation (weeks 2–4): sampling + automated comparisons, identify defects (rounding, duplication, missing dimensions), ship fixes, add alerts.
3) Experiment analysis + pricing guidance draft (weeks 4–6): analysis notebooks/sheets, exec readout, draft enablement + internal FAQs.
4) Publish + operationalize (weeks 6–8): Confluence guidance, runbooks, close checklist updates, Sales/CS training, and ongoing monitoring.

Deliverables:
- Confluence: canonical meter definitions + billing mapping, experiment readout, decisions/ADRs on rounding/accounting, support runbook for billing disputes, and enablement guidance.
- Google Drive: working datasets (sheets), reconciliation results, sensitivity analyses, and exec presentation.
- Engineering artifacts: Linear execution plan, GitHub PRs for meter fixes and alerting, and Jira tickets documenting customer-impacting discrepancies/refunds.

Constraints:
- Must preserve auditability: every billed unit should be explainable from raw telemetry with documented transformations.
- Changes affecting invoices require cross-functional sign-off (Finance + Engineering + Legal) and careful rollout/communication.
- Experiment conclusions must account for seasonality, cohort effects, and sampling bias (e.g., self-serve vs enterprise).

files.description: Program overview: meter inventory, goals, timelines, owners, and how reconciliation ties to invoicing and close; includes definitions of ‘source of truth’ datasets and sign-off checkpoints.
Canonical meter dictionary for hosted API (input/output tokens, cached tokens, embeddings, rerank units, requests, streaming) with edge cases, rounding, and versioning notes.
Mapping from invoice line items to telemetry fields/dimensions (model, region, customer tier, endpoint type) including examples and common mismatch causes.
Methodology for sanity checks: sampling strategy, expected tolerances, reconciliation queries, how to interpret deltas (retries, batching, partial streams), and acceptance thresholds.

Operational runbook for Support/Finance: intake template, required artifacts, how to reproduce usage, escalation to telemetry team, refund/credit approval flow, and customer-facing explanation patterns.
Close controls update: pre-invoice meter health checks, anomaly review, reconciliation sign-offs, and audit-ready evidence checklist.
ADR documenting final decisions on rounding policy (per-request vs per-invoice aggregation) and how streaming partial completions and disconnects are accounted for.
Catalog of active and recent pricing/packaging experiments: hypotheses, variants, eligibility rules, guardrails, primary metrics, and owners.
Experiment readout: results by cohort, statistical notes, impact on conversion/retention/GM, recommended next actions (ship/iterate/stop), and identified measurement caveats.
Internal guidance for when to recommend Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private; includes pricing levers, metering differences, and common deal structures.
Enablement FAQ: how meters work, how to explain token accounting, handling customer disputes, quoting guidance during experiments, and escalation contacts.
Legal guidance: recommended contract language for ‘measurement and billing’, dispute windows, audit rights, treatment of retries/failed requests, and references to product docs.
Working doc + table summary of reconciliation sample A (January): per-account deltas, suspected causes, links to supporting queries/dashboards, and follow-up owners.
Second reconciliation sample (February): expanded coverage of streaming + retries; notes on variance distribution and acceptance thresholds.
Sheet-style case log of billing disputes: Jira keys, account, amount at risk, root cause category (meter bug vs misunderstanding), resolution and approvals.
Sensitivity analysis sheet: gross margin impact vs GPU costs, cache hit rates, and token price changes; includes scenario notes for Dedicated commits.
Messy working notes for experiment analysis: cohort definitions, data exclusions, open questions, and links to query outputs and dashboards.
Draft spec for the experiment metrics dashboard (dimensions, required event properties, guardrail alerts); includes instrumentation gaps and owners.
Slides draft for Sales/CS enablement: what changed, how to position, FAQs, example invoices/usage pages, and talk tracks for objections.
Engineering working doc: proposed anomaly detection checks, thresholds, oncall routing, and dashboard links; includes rough queries and false-positive notes.
Test plan doc for billing hooks: integration test matrix, replay strategy, environments, and sign-off criteria with Finance.
Exec readout document: key findings, customer risk, financial impact, decisions needed (ship/rollback), and resourcing asks.
Implement automated daily meter reconciliation job comparing raw telemetry aggregates vs billing-ready aggregates; acceptance criteria include per-dimension diffs and alert hooks.
Fix streaming token accounting bug (disconnect handling) and backfill affected period; includes rollout plan and customer impact assessment.
Add ‘retry_reason’ / ‘request_outcome’ dimensions to metering pipeline to separate billed vs non-billed tokens; includes cardinality constraints.
Create meter anomaly dashboards + alerts (spend spikes, negative deltas, missing dimensions) routed to #finance and SRE oncall.
Console alignment: ensure usage page matches invoice aggregation (rounding, time zones, model aliases); includes QA plan with Finance sample invoices.
Define success metrics and guardrails for Q1 pricing experiments; includes experiment registry requirements and decision cadence.
Packaging decision proposal: adjust free-credit structure + overage tiers; includes required analyses and stakeholder review checklist.
Publish pricing/metering guidance (Confluence + enablement deck) and run live training for Sales/CS; includes deliverables and due dates.
Coordinate legal review of ‘measurement and billing’ language updates; includes dependencies on counsel feedback and timeline to apply to new MSAs.
Backfill and audit: regenerate billing aggregates for a targeted window and validate no customer invoice deltas beyond tolerance; includes audit evidence artifact list.
PR: Add daily reconciliation workflow (scheduled job + summary output) for meter sanity checks; includes alerting integration and configuration.
PR: Fix rounding behavior in invoice aggregator to match documented ADR (per-request rounding removed); adds regression tests.
PR: Correct streaming disconnect accounting (do not bill tokens after client disconnect; ensure partial usage is captured); includes backfill notes.
PR: Add request outcome/retry dimensions to metering events and downstream aggregation; includes cardinality safeguards.
PR: New dashboards for meter deltas and anomaly detection; alerts to #finance and #eng-sre with runbook links.
PR: Console usage page alignment fixes (time zone normalization, model alias mapping); includes QA screenshots and rollout steps.
PR: Improve billing export schema (explicit meter_version, aggregation_window, and invoice_run_id) to support auditability.
PR: Add integration test harness for billing hooks with replayed production-like telemetry samples; includes golden files and CI job.
